hooks.text: 每站必须在时限内启动保险丝并赶回末班地铁，超时会引来此前站点累积的尸潮。
hooks.excerpt: Only by activating the fuse at each stop within the time limit can you move on. Fail… and a brutal fight for survival awaits.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战斗中收集技能芯片，解锁能力并定制本轮roguelike构筑。
hooks.excerpt: Skill Chips & Upgrades Collect Skill Chips during combat to unlock powerful abilities and customize your build.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 作为末班地铁唯一乘客，逐站接近可能仍在市政厅等待的家人。
hooks.excerpt: You boarded the final subway still in operation, bound for a single destination: City Hall , where your family might still be waiting. But this train isn’t just your escape—it’s a gauntlet.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
